subject: design/review-feedback-capture
statement: the writer declares a consumer-side port `CaptureSource` yielding a schema-versioned `CapturedComment{comment, author, timestamp, subject_anchor, source_id}` (AP-6). Two adapters implement it — `conversation` (an explicit capture invocation carrying one confirmed operator comment) and `code-host` (webhook/poll comment ingestion) — each using its medium's mechanism internally. The writer core imports neither adapter; the boundary is a lint rule, not convention.
